name: Apex
strategy: Test on the development computer first, then publish the portable or installer package without replacing user data.
notes: 1.0.129: Güncel Fiş Asistanı korunarak mükellef/cari ekleme formu ve Apex gömülü pencere görünürlüğü düzeltildi.
1.0.127 reads final payable amounts from positioned PDF text and full invoice-page text, preserving ledger-specific rules and multi-invoice uploads.
1.0.126 scopes withholding/service-base comparison to invoice versus ledger credit rows; invoice versus invoice retains final payable matching.
1.0.125 compares final payable amounts only, automatically recognizes supported files and displays only missing, extra or differing records.
1.0.124 improves invoice party extraction and reconciles document numbers with comparable amounts while preserving original evidence and name/date details.
1.0.123 fixes comparison client identity matching, deleted client reappearance, and separates new-client entry from read-only selected-client details.
1.0.122 adds comparison client management and muavin PDF/Excel uploads on both sides.
1.0.121 adds Zirve muavin PDF/Excel reconciliation by document number, document date and counterparty, preserving the original PDF/ZIP invoice workflow.
1.0.120 restores Stock Tracking; mixed-date ZIP invoices post to their invoice months with automatic validation and recalculated stock and VAT carry-forward.
1.0.119 verifies installer version and checksum, waits for authorized handoff, and verifies the installed ASAR version before reporting success.
1.0.113 speeds up Apex startup by rendering the home screen before heavier package/dashboard refresh work and by deferring market-rate refreshes without recursive redraws.
1.0.111 embeds the updated Kase/Imza HTML, restores the standalone HTML from the protected bundled copy if it is deleted, and adds a Kase/Imza settings button to download a rebuilt HTML file.
1.0.108 makes Tahakkuk Gonder year selection compact and multi-select, places year/month side by side, auto-generates years from 2015 through the current year, and scans selected years together.
1.0.107 moves backup/restore controls into Data Security and Settings, modernizes the update check action, and refreshes the Tahakkuk Gonder visual design without changing install data.
1.0.106 fixes scheduled Tahakkuk Gonder completion status, prevents false expired warnings for completed scheduled sends, and adds edit date/time for pending schedules.

1.0.105 adds persistent scheduled Tahakkuk Gonder queue with date/time picker, pending/sent/cancelled status list, cancel, add-file, expired-on-open cancellation notice, and clearable completed history.
1.0.104 adds scheduled Tahakkuk Gonder sending, manual file sending from Downloads when no source is selected, button order changes, and resets year on clear.
User records are stored outside the program folder.
1.0.102 fully disables the old external Tahakkuk Gonder launcher and embeds the current offline Kase/Imza HTML in Apex and the stable bookmark path.
1.0.101 makes Apex internal minimize behave like a multi-item taskbar and moves Kase/Imza to an ASCII-safe app path.
1.0.100 fixes Paket Programlar minus behavior to minimize inside Apex with a transparent restore bar instead of minimizing Windows.
1.0.99 restores the Paket Programlar/Tahakkuk Gonder minus button and minimizes Apex to the Windows taskbar.

1.0.98 improves Tahakkuk Gonder month picker closing, removes redundant firm edit button, updates home metrics, fixes updater target/elevation checks, adds startup update prompt, and stabilizes Baserow sync restart.
1.0.97 restores Vergi Levhası in Tahakkuk Gonder and scans DOKUMANLAR/VERGI LEVHALARI for the newest PDF.
1.0.96 moves Tahakkuk Gonder silent PDF printing to bundled SumatraPDF command-line printing to prevent black-page output.
Installer updates replace the program while keeping Documents/Apex intact.
0.8.2 separates bank data by profile, simplifies the top bar, replaces tasks with upcoming payments, and moves data safety into the home menu.
0.9.0 adds GIB Evrak Merkezi for assisted e-Beyanname document downloads by vergilendirme donemi without storing passwords.
0.9.1 adds assisted GIB search from the portal to e-Beyanname query screens with VKN/TCKN, period and declaration type.
0.9.2 improves e-Beyanname card detection on Dijital Vergi Dairesi and avoids mistaking the portal search box for VKN/TCKN.
0.9.3 adds a direct e-Beyanname session link opener for time-critical GIB workflows; links are not stored.
0.9.4 follows the real GIB flow: E-Beyanname, Beyanname Ara, VKN/TCKN, Beyanname Turu, Vergilendirme Donemi and Onaylandi filters.
0.9.5 simplifies GIB Evrak Merkezi to a saved direct e-Beyanname link and one Indir button.
0.9.6 runs the direct GIB window hidden and improves text-node clicking for E-Beyanname and Beyanname Ara links.
0.9.7 sets Yukleme Tarih Araligi to the next month for period declarations, e.g. Mart 2026 KDV1 uses 01/04/2026-30/04/2026.
0.9.8 maps KDV1 to Katma Deger Vergisi Beyannamesi 1 in GIB and accepts the visible single result row.
0.9.9 relaxes GIB Onaylandi detection and treats the single matching visible result as approved.
0.9.18 strengthens local save ordering, adds a Not filter, simplifies Fatura Indir, and makes the Zirve robot stop at the end of the saved list.
0.9.19 keeps notes period-specific and lightens table rendering for smoother scrolling.
1.0.0 opens bank access for Mehmet and adds Kasim-only profile add/remove management.
1.0.1 renames Kontrol Listeleri to Excel Kontrol and adds two-file invoice number comparison with missing invoice Excel export.
1.0.2 tightens invoice number detection and adds Zirve-style voucher Excel generation for missing invoices.
1.0.3 fixes Excel Kontrol voucher creation: sale/purchase debit-credit rules, clean company names, proper dates and no account-name column.
1.0.4 fixes voucher amount extraction from incoming journal rows and prevents empty zero-total voucher rows.
1.0.5 treats 770/760/740 and similar expense accounts as purchase voucher debit lines, so service invoices no longer produce zero-total vouchers.
1.0.6 ignores duplicated summary account rows in journal voucher generation and computes sales receivable from 600+391 instead of repeated 320/120 closing rows.
1.0.7 treats Indirilecek KDV and Al.Fat journal blocks as purchase vouchers even when the closing row says Alicilar/120, outputting 320 credit instead.
1.0.8 rebuilds voucher classification around account roots: 25x fixed assets, 15x stock, 7xx expenses, 191 purchases, 600/391 sales, and 610/611/612 sales return/discount vouchers.
1.0.9 adds separate declaration tracking groups, smarter status rollback, and faster immediate UI feedback for status/value changes.
1.0.10 fixes tracking group creation, removes the recent-actions box, opens one declaration month behind by default, modernizes Apex alerts, and relaunches Apex after installer updates.
1.0.11 fixes Baserow sync preserving declaration tracking groups so newly created groups no longer disappear after pull.
1.0.12 adds the first Akilli Evrak center: document reading form, voucher suggestion, and transport-sector fuel rules that route mazot/akaryakit to 770 instead of 153.
1.0.13 fixes installer updates for Program Files installs by requesting elevation before replacing Apex and relaunching after installation.
1.0.14 makes updates visible and reliable: Apex opens an update helper, waits for the app to close, starts the installer with Windows permission, then relaunches Apex.
1.0.15 adds in-app update progress steps and replaces remaining native Windows confirm/prompt dialogs with Apex-style modern dialogs.

1.0.16 adds the POS/OKC foundation with local encrypted GIB credentials, fixes rare status rollback jitter, and optimizes declaration tracking clicks/scrolling by debouncing saves and refreshing only the changed row.
1.0.17 fixes in-app update asset selection and prevents the downloader from hanging indefinitely while fetching installer files.

1.0.18 hardens declaration status changes with immediate local persistence, double-trigger protection, and a post-click status guard so sent declarations cannot silently fall back to invoice-downloaded.
1.0.19 rebuilds the update downloader with real progress reporting, redirect-safe GitHub downloads, visible install status, and clear failure messages instead of staying on 'indiriliyor'.
1.0.20 links the same taxpayer across declaration groups by Turkish-insensitive name matching for status, notes, payable KDV and descriptions while keeping delete operations group-specific.
1.0.21 fixes the installer handoff path used by in-app updates so the downloaded update can start instead of failing with dataRoot is not defined.

1.0.22 is a declaration tracking stability and performance pass: Baserow pulls merge instead of overwriting local edits, group deletes stay group-specific, taxpayer add/delete/transfer tools were added, row delete buttons were removed, and search/render work was reduced.
1.0.23 makes installer updates more reliable with a visible/logged helper, keeps Apex dialogs above the update center, and refreshes the desktop/in-app Apex icon with a clean round symbol.
1.0.24 adds support for the new e-Beyan Beyannameler screen: Apex can use the row action menu, open PDF Listele, and download Beyanname/Tahakkuk PDFs into the taxpayer archive folder.
1.0.25 redesigns GIB Evrak Merkezi with an e-Beyan REST API test panel, encrypted local API key storage, and approved declaration listing by taxpayer, type and taxation period.
1.0.27 rebuilds the e-Beyan API test package above installed 1.0.26 versions and improves connection error messages.
1.0.28 switches GIB Evrak Merkezi to the new e-Beyan Beyannameler filter flow: period, taxpayer, declaration type and approved status are filled on the page before downloading B/T PDFs.
1.0.29 forces the filter downloader to open the new e-Beyan Beyannameler URL, waits for the page to load, and prevents fallback to the old Beyanname Ara flow.

1.0.30 keeps the new e-Beyan filter flow isolated from the old screen, shows the Apex GIB login window when the app session is not open, and reports the active page address when filtering cannot start.

1.0.31 simplifies GIB Evrak Merkezi to a single Indir flow, stores GIB login credentials locally, starts from Dijital Vergi Dairesi login, and continues through e-Beyan/Hizli Menu/Beyannameler before downloading Beyan and Tahakkuk PDFs.

1.0.32 hardens Program Files updates: new installers are machine-wide, old release leftovers are cleaned before packaging, and the updater launches a visible elevated helper that closes old Apex processes, installs, logs, and relaunches Apex.

1.0.33 fixes the GIB download flow by saving GIB credentials profile-wide, reusing an already open GIB window, using stronger login field detection, and retrying e-Beyan / HÄ±zlÄ± MenÃ¼ navigation before filtering declarations.
1.0.34 migrates old taxpayer-specific GIB login records by falling back to the first saved credential when the selected taxpayer has no direct credential yet.
1.0.35 adds a separate Dijital Vergi Dairesi login prefill step and catches GIB page script errors so Apex shows the real automation error instead of remote method failure.

1.0.36 keeps the GIB download flow alive after captcha login and uses native window clicks for the Dijital Vergi Dairesi e-Beyan card, confirmation dialog and e-Beyan quick menu when page clicks do not fire.
1.0.37 always sends a native click to the Dijital Vergi Dairesi e-Beyan card and follow-up e-Beyan controls instead of trusting page-click success reports that may not navigate.
1.0.38 tracks the separate e-Beyan window opened by Dijital Vergi Dairesi and, once e-Beyan is open, jumps directly to the Beyannameler page so Apex can handle filters and PDF downloads.
1.0.39 optimizes declaration status clicks by replacing full-table undo snapshots with lightweight row history and moving disk/sync persistence off the immediate click path.
1.0.40 starts the Zirve invoice download robot directly from Apex without UAC/elevation, keeps the BAT file as a no-permission fallback, and removes the old 'run as administrator' path.
1.0.41 fixes the installer handoff by passing the NSIS target folder in the correct /D form and verifying the installed Apex version after update.
1.0.42 launches the Zirve invoice downloader through the generated BAT with cmd start, matching the manual double-click path that works reliably.
1.0.43 replaces cmd start with PowerShell Start-Process for the generated BAT, fixing the Windows network path error shown as \\ not found.
1.0.44 switches Apex to per-user installation so updates no longer require Windows elevation/UAC and avoids Program Files path parsing problems.
1.0.47 restores the Zirve invoice downloader to the pre-today 1.0.42 robot script and starts the generated BAT from Apex instead of the experimental direct PowerShell path.
1.0.48 adds live USD/EUR/GBP and gold rate cards to the home control panel, plus live taxpayer search suggestions with declaration status.
1.0.49 restores machine-wide installation with elevation support so Apex installs under Program Files for all users again.
1.0.50 restores declaration summary cards on the home control panel and redesigns market rate cards with compact colored buy/sell values without time labels.
1.0.51 removes the home control panel header/period badge and makes market buy/sell values fit cleanly in compact cards.
1.0.52 adds the standalone Borc Takip module with its own taxpayer list, payment types, Adana tax offices, partial payments, carry-forward unpaid debts, filtering, totals and PDF preview/export.
1.0.53 compacts Borc Takip for smaller Apex windows, moves debt/client/type entry into popups, removes full-row status colors and installs the updated payment-status layout.
1.0.54 tightens Beyanname Takip PDF print spacing so 30 taxpayer rows fit on each page.
1.0.55 adds the modern Settings gear with appearance, profile management, customizable declaration types/actions, cross-profile taxpayer transfer, and removes the top-bar Beyanname Takip shortcut.

1.0.56 separates status buttons, tool buttons and filters in Settings, restores colored declaration summary cards, removes Reports from declaration tracking, and fixes modal scrolling for small Apex windows.
1.0.57 keeps Settings and popups fully inside small Apex windows with reachable close controls, and lets custom filters auto-create or use matching action buttons such as KDV2.

1.0.58 simplifies custom tool/filter setup: tool buttons and filters use only their visible names, filters bind to exact matching tool names, and custom tools such as KDV2 mark rows independently without changing declaration status colors.

1.0.59 adds up/down ordering for status and tool buttons, colors custom status rows across the full table row, and repairs filters so labels such as BORDRO HAZIR match the same visible status button instead of a stray tool filter.

1.0.60 keeps status badges single-line and centered in the status column, stabilizes declaration table column widths, and fixes Excel/PDF exports so renamed or custom statuses never appear as undefined.

1.0.61 syncs Apex settings such as custom declaration/status/tool/filter buttons between computers, restores the KDV1 Not tool without affecting MUHSGK, keeps declaration-type tools isolated, and strengthens active row colors.

1.0.62 fixes cross-computer declaration status syncing by merging status changes by their own timestamps, preserving remote resets, and mapping legacy status ids such as hazir to renamed/custom synced status buttons.

1.0.69 publishes the latest live Apex fixes: Baserow sync errors are shown clearly, large local history is pruned before sync, row reads use cached Baserow IDs, and repaired taxpayer names/settings are included for new installs.

1.0.70 adds Paket Programlar > Beyanname Kontrol: Zirve PDF/Excel/CSV firm lists are matched against Apex declaration tracking with Turkish-insensitive smart name matching, missing submitted declarations are reported, and firms not found in Apex are listed separately with Excel, PDF preview, and PNG output.
1.0.71 fixes Beyanname Kontrol type selection, improves PDF line extraction, and compares the selected declaration type across all tracking groups as one combined taxpayer pool.

1.0.72 filters legal suffix fragments from Beyanname Kontrol PDF imports, improves short-name matching such as person names, removes score/note columns from reports, and keeps PDF preview above Paket Programlar.
1.0.73 adds Paket Programlar > Tahakkuk Gönder, launching the Zirve WhatsApp tahakkuk/beyanname sender from the Apex package menu.
1.0.74 opens Tahakkuk Gönder from the shared Zirve network package first, so all Apex computers use the same sender and taxpayer list.
1.0.75 embeds Tahakkuk Gönder directly inside the Apex Paket Programlar modal instead of launching a separate HTA/window.
1.0.76 removes the Zirvenet/Apex shared folder dependency and seeds Tahakkuk Gönder data from the installer into Apex's own data folder.
